resources.string: Public feeds, in-app reading and a research side panel.
Read the story. Question the market impact.

This optional reader connects directly to FT Chinese, MarketWatch, BBC Business, DW and the Federal Reserve, even in backend mode. Public feeds require no paid API. Article access may require a subscription. It does not use the calendar proxy, backend credentials or AI. Opening an article fetches its public page. AI runs only when you choose Analyze or Send.

No reports here yet. Refresh or change the filter.
Extracted text may be incomplete or include subscription notices. It is not verified as the complete article. Publication time is shown above; fetching time does not indicate when the story broke.
Long text shortened to 24,000 characters. AI receives at most 18,000 characters and is told if shortened.
Readable page text was unavailable. Showing the feed summary, not the full article. Try the in-app original page; subscriptions and access restrictions still apply.

Original site in an isolated WebView. Scripts are off by default. Webpage contents, cookies and logins are not sent to AI; it still uses the extracted text or RSS summary.
Allow page scripts for this article
Enabling scripts allows the publisher and its third parties to execute webpage code and make network requests. App credentials remain unavailable. Enable only if you trust this site.
This page could not be loaded in app. Return to reading mode or retry. No external browser was opened.

Analyze / Send shares the title, source, publication time, extracted text (or summary) and recent questions with your personal AI endpoint. Optional quotes follow the selected data-source mode. Provider fees may apply. No cookies or login state are shared.
Configure your personal AI key, endpoint and model in Settings to analyze. News reading needs no AI key.
Quotes are current snapshots, not a before/after study of this news. Missing or stale data is disclosed to the model.

Analyze this news: separate reported facts from inference, explain transmission to relevant markets, give short- and medium-term conditional scenarios, opposing risks and missing evidence. State whether the evidence is extracted text or only a summary.
Analysis failed. Check your AI settings or network and try again. Your question remains editable.
Conditional analysis, not a price prediction or investment advice. Conversations stay in this screen session and are not saved to disk.
